description: This file defines the EmployeeSalaryDao class, which manages database operations related to EmployeeSalary entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, deleting, retrieving, and counting employee salary records, as well as handling pagination and search filtering.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for EmployeeSalary entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and search functionalities.

methods.name: saveEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Persists a new or existing EmployeeSalary record to the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeDirectDebit
methods.description: Deletes an EmpDirectDebit entity from the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeSalary records for a specific employee based on salary IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeSalary record by employee number and salary ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeSalaryIdsByEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns existing salary IDs for an employee filtered by a list of IDs.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Fetches employee salary records based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalariesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee salary records matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeSalariesPaginator
methods.description: Creates and configures a paginator object for employee salaries based on search filters.
